name: @openclaw-workbench/desktop
description: njx-copilot — macOS desktop shell for OpenClaw Workbench (Electron).

scripts.dist:mac: PYTHON_PATH=/usr/bin/python3 npm run build && PYTHON_PATH=/usr/bin/python3 electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: PYTHON_PATH=/usr/bin/python3 npm run build && PYTHON_PATH=/usr/bin/python3 electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac:arm64:dir: PYTHON_PATH=/usr/bin/python3 npm run build && PYTHON_PATH=/usr/bin/python3 electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac:x64: PYTHON_PATH=/usr/bin/python3 npm run build && PYTHON_PATH=/usr/bin/python3 electron-builder --mac --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
